Title: NexusTK 5.33 client disassembly — mob palette/colour semantics
Author: project1998-docs sprite-palette session
Notes: NexusTK.exe 5.33 static disassembly: monster draw 0x447975 (reads MONSTER.DNA paletteIndex, passes colour>>5 to the palette manager), palette manager 0x48ab40 (colour>>5 >= 1 returns SUPER{n}.PAL, else MONSTER.PAL block[paletteIndex % blockCount]), blitter 0x4392a0 (sprite indices >= 0x30 read palette[(i + 8*colour) & 0xFF]; below 0x30 unshifted). Validated against 356 NexusAtlas reference GIFs (project1998-docs site/report-mob-look-check.html, mean colour distance 0.38 -> 0.17).
